Record Class BenchmarkRisk.Result

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
grafioschtrader.reportviews.performance.BenchmarkRisk.Result
Record Components:
riskObservations - size of the risk sample
benchmarkVolatilityAnnualizedPercent - annualized volatility of the benchmark over the risk sample
benchmarkMaxDrawdownPercent - deepest decline of the benchmark linked over the common intervals, negative, 0 without a decline
trackingErrorPercent - annualized deviation of the active returns
informationRatio - annualized mean active return per unit of tracking error
beta - sensitivity of the portfolio to the benchmark
correlation - correlation of the two return series
jensenAlphaAnnualizedPercent - return above the risk-adjusted benchmark return, per year
upCapturePercent - share of the rising benchmark intervals the portfolio captured
downCapturePercent - share of the falling benchmark intervals the portfolio took part in
Enclosing class:
BenchmarkRisk

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal.
